sentences.text:
Tushar Kanti Ghosh & Anr vs The State Of West Bengal & Ors
on 15 September, 2023
Author: Suvra Ghosh

Bench: Suvra Ghosh
 22
15.09.2023
Ct.No.10
b.das
 Wpa No. 15896 of 2023
 Tushar Kanti Ghosh & Anr.
 Vs.
 The State of West Bengal & Ors.
 Mr. Panchanan Hajra ...for the petitioners.

Mr. Pritam Chowdhury
 Mr. Ritesh Kr. Ganguly ...for the State.
Affidavit of service filed by the petitioners is taken on  record.

It is contended on behalf of the petitioners that the  land of the petitioners was requisitioned in terms of the West Bengal Land (Requisition and Acquisition) Act, 1948  but the land was not acquired subsequently.

entities.text: West Bengal Land (Requisition and Acquisition) Act, 1948
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: In the  meantime the said Act of 1948 stood repealed with effect  from March 31, 1997 and the scheme for which such  requisition was made was abandoned.

The petitioners submitted a representation before  the concerned authority on 29th May, 2023 praying for  release of their land and payment of compensation but  the representation is yet to be considered.

The petitioners  pray for a direction upon the concerned authority to Tushar Kanti Ghosh & Anr vs The State Of West Bengal & Ors on 15 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/154918468/
1  consider the representation at the earliest.

sentences.text: In view of the above, the writ petition is disposed of  directing the 4th respondent to consider and dispose of the representation submitted by the petitioners on 29 th May, 2023 within a period of three months from the date of communication of this order upon affording reasonable opportunity of hearing to all the interested persons including the petitioners, in accordance with law.
In the event the representation is decided in favour of the petitioners, necessary consequential steps be taken by the 4th respondent within a month thereof.
There shall be, however, no order as to costs.
Since no affidavit is invited, the allegations contained in the petition are deemed not to be admitted.

opennyai_summary.facts:
It is contended on behalf of the petitioners that the  land of the petitioners was requisitioned in terms of the West Bengal Land (Requisition and Acquisition) Act, 1948  but the land was not acquired subsequently.
The petitioners submitted a representation before  the concerned authority on 29th May, 2023 praying for  release of their land and payment of compensation but  the representation is yet to be considered.
opennyai_summary.decision:
In the  meantime the said Act of 1948 stood repealed with effect  from March 31, 1997 and the scheme for which such  requisition was made was abandoned.
In view of the above, the writ petition is disposed of  directing the 4th respondent to consider and dispose of the representation submitted by the petitioners on 29 th May, 2023 within a period of three months from the date of communication of this order upon affording reasonable opportunity of hearing to all the interested persons including the petitioners, in accordance with law.
In the event the representation is decided in favour of the petitioners, necessary consequential steps be taken by the 4th respondent within a month thereof.
There shall be, however, no order as to costs.
Since no affidavit is invited, the allegations contained in the petition are deemed not to be admitted.
Urgent certified website copy of this order, if applied for, be supplied to the parties upon compliance with all requisite formalities.
